{{quote|Lie still Shaarad, or I will say I have touched you armed and allow you to choose how your honor stands.|Chiad while tending to a wounded [[Gaul]] during the [[Battle of Emond's Field]]}}
'''Chiad''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Stones River]] sept of the [[Goshien]] [[Aiel]] who crossed the [[Dragonwall]]. She is bonded as a [[first-sister]] to [[Bain]].

== Appearance ==
Chiad has short reddish-blond hair and gray eyes.

==Activities==
=== Tear and the Two Rivers ===
Chiad meets [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] on their way to [[Tear]]. She leads them to [[Dailin (maiden)|Dailin]] who has been injured.{{ref/book|3|38}} They reveal they are searching for "He Who Comes With the Dawn." She is one of the Aiel present when the [[Stone of Tear]] falls.

Chiad later joins [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile]] when she heads to the [[Two Rivers]] to confront the [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]].{{ref/book|4|18}} There seems to be an attraction between [[Gaul]] and her, even though their respective clans have a blood feud with each other. She stays with Gaul to fight Trollocs during the [[Battle of Emond's Field]] instead of going with Faile and Bain to Watch Hill.{{ref/book|4|56}}

=== Dumai's Wells ===
Chiad accompanies Faile when she goes with [[Perrin Aybara]] to meet [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Caemlyn]]. Gaul wants to marry her, but she doesn't want to give up the spear. She is Rand's guard when he is taken by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]].  

She fights in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. 
=== Made ''gai'shain'' ===
[[File:Bain and Chiad by googoolini.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Pencil sketch of Bain and Chiad by Googolini]]Chiad then moves out with Perrin and Faile when they [[Traveling|Travel]] to [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]]. While out hunting, she is captured by the [[Shaido]] and made ''[[gai'shain]]''.

She helps [[Arrela Shiego]] and [[Lacile Aldorwin]] escape the Shaido camp but refuses to escape herself. She and Bain help Faile by making sure captive [[Dairaine Saighan]] doesn't run to [[Sevanna]] to inform her of Faile's planned escape.

During the [[Battle of Malden]], she is rescued by Gaul and now serves as his ''gai'shain''. She recovers some clothing of [[Rolan]], [[Kinhuin]], and [[Jhoradin]] so that Faile can carry out a funeral service for the fallen men.

Bain offers Gaul some freshly sharpened spears the day of Perrin's trial. She travels with Perrin and the rest of his huge force to the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]]. Bain and Chiad watch Gaul leave through the gateway with Perrin in their attempt to stop [[Slayer]].

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Chiad}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Maja Simonsen}}.
